annotations.text:
SignalGap evidence view — BUILT, and corrected against the running app.

Every number is what the rules engine actually computes: 95/100, 2 independent categories, and the score reasons word for word.

One correction after building: this lead carries "Needs a recheck", not "Coverage gap". One of its links is dead, and that flag outranks the gap label. The first draft of this canvas showed a label the rules would never produce.

Right: one layout alternative, and three ways to show the demo's central moment.

Single column, 768px of reading width.

Why: it matches the shell already approved, it reads top to bottom in the spec's order, and it works on a phone with no rework.

Cost: the brief sits ~2000px below the evidence it summarises, so checking a brief claim against a source means scrolling.

Direction B: the brief stays on screen while you scroll the evidence.

Why: the demo move is checking a brief claim against its source. Here they are side by side.

Cost: needs ~1280px. On a phone it collapses back to Direction A anyway, so it is a second layout to build and keep working, not a replacement.
Only one of these three ships. A is what the plan currently describes. B and C are here because this is the moment the whole product is arguing for, and a numbered list may be underselling it.
